vulnerability_analysis: The contract uses .transfer() in transferToAddressETH() with fixed 2300 gas stipend. If marketing address is a contract with complex fallback, transfers may fail, locking BNB. The owner can call Sweep() to drain all BNB. The vulnerability allows owner to drain contract BNB regardless of marketing address failures.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call Sweep() to drain all BNB from the contract to the owner address. Use deal() to ensure contract has BNB balance for the exploit.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the contract owner. 2. Use deal() to give the target contract BNB balance. 3. Call Sweep() on the target contract. 4. Verify attacker balance increased.
